{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''ET North Side to Paris Loop''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is located in Texas.

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Energy Transfer LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''350 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''145 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30, 36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2008<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
